{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Charcoal wool-blend tailored trousers, straight leg, full ankle length, charcoal grey (#3b3f45), thick brushed wool with a warm lining
Fine-gauge merino turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, soft ivory (#f1ece2), 100% merino wool
Textured knit blazer-style cardigan, relaxed tailored fit, mid-hip length, deep navy (#26364f), dense wool bouclé
Insulated winter coat, straight cut, knee length with a hood, black (#1c1b1d), water-repellent wool-blend outer with a down-feather fill
Waterproof ankle boots, low block heel, round toe, black (#1a1a1a), sealed leather with a grippy rubber lug sole and fleece lining
Thermal tights worn under the trousers, opaque, black (#1e1e20), fleece-lined stretch knit
Chunky scarf, wide and long, dusty blue (#7f95ad), soft lambswool
Knitted beanie, snug fit, charcoal melange (#4a4d52), wool with a fleece band
Lined leather gloves, black (#1c1b1d), leather with a cashmere-blend lining
Structured tote bag, medium size, black (#222124), water-resistant coated leather

This outfit suits a snowy deep-frost walk to the office while keeping the neat business look your workday needs. The trousers, turtleneck and textured cardigan layer into a polished, put-together look, and the warm lining and thermal tights keep the cold out during the 20-minute walk. The waterproof lug-sole boots handle snow and road salt without losing their tidy shape. The dusty blue scarf echoes your eye color and the navy and ivory sit softly against your fair skin and dark hair."}
